translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Doku Tau Tau Kimakopene Wesi More Qesiŋonikei Wane Edange
Yuda miti ŋei maulukone more wesi ebonikei wane, ea mo maine detmami, ea wane daleo zok qe ŋibonikale.

Iwamo na detmaile Akaia doku tau tau magu ŋine koma qei bano wesi maratka more qeturaŋ ea kiekkoi, na don kisi ea Makedonia ŋei edanbe, ŋei natne korop eŋe ŋinane sorin borin so togole togole ŋinane kisi detpi qomene kitoke.
Ŋene mawalak ŋungone yewaŋo wele midaine okaniakane na kimakopne biraonbe uwi ŋine siluŋ na rakole yale waka kine kine okan onikei wane ewekkei.
Na Makedonia ŋei eŋerop weneŋ uŋem ŋine wesi mot mot wane ŋaŋaekeiwo, eŋe kau don yewa wele midaine okangi ŋine so na weneŋ gamu kutzo wayake, paki ŋine koso mane mi mauluk ŋunikene.
Ea wane kimakopne raonbe alakane umami. U lotkeu qom menaŋ wesi mosikeiwane nolatkoi, ea lewine ma qeturage motpi mesiake. Eamo aŋa togon wesi midaka, mitiwane qom menaŋ wesi, sikanonikei.
Qomi Qomineka Kine Kine Mot Mot Me Oka Okan Ea Wane Anutuŋo Detki Menaŋ Okanmaike
So iwa yale desikei, Mane eŋe waet ewekine ebosiake eŋe wele ewekineka mane qene okaniake, ŋo mane eŋe waet loutne ebosiake eŋe wele loutne mane qene okaniake.

Ea wane iwa yale okanwarekei. Mane eŋe qomne bapene mi raki paki kine kineine qom ewekinane rokopko mosiake, qebi qebingo me aŋa togon wane midaka. Kine kine yaup qomne bapne mi raki paki mosiake, ŋei yaline eŋane Anutuŋo detki simileka okanmaike.
So Anutu eŋe zonom welaineŋo qom ewekinane mosop ŋungi morian wakone ŋibongi ŋinŋine mane qene okane ge more urata kine kine maine maikei wane kine kine mane mi zuaŋgei.
Ea wane Anutu wane Papiao iwa yale qeqine,

content.text: “Eŋe ma pororoke damo qe aboŋene midaine ebon okanmaike, eŋane mayakatneineŋo papa togon pa ariake.”

Eŋe ŋei waet ma wakone ebongi qe met okan okanmami so wele ma wakone ebongi ma ne okan okanmami, Anutu eŋe ŋine yaleka qe met okanikei wane, waet ma wakone ŋibone more mosopkaki qom ewekŋinane wele wakone sua leule okaniake.
Pakimo riwe morian gorop okane, ŋei aboŋene midaine kito qesiŋ okan okanikei, eŋe ŋenane ra more Anutu bakom mawa mawa okankaikei.
Ŋine miti ŋei wet pese kine kine okanonbi, eaŋo bodi ŋine esop kayake, eaka midaka, eaŋo bakom mawa mawa ea wane morian ma wakongi, Anutu wane okaniake.

Ŋine Kristo wane miti don dere tewek okan okanmami, ea wane kine wet pesek kine kineŋineŋo ma wakongi miti ŋei so doku tau tau magu natne korop eŋerop kima kima tako rakotŋine wakongi, eŋe baŋ Anutu mawakaikei.
So ŋinano Anutu mitiinane wele wakone sua leule okanmaikane, weteneŋo lukŋune more Anutu meŋenkaikei.
Ŋene Anutu wane bakom maine mi ra wakonikene, yaup welelepke more mawakaŋem!
